verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four bases of psychic power.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṁ iddhipādaṁ bhāveti,
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant develops the basis of psychic power that has immersion due to enthusiasm …
These are the four bases of psychic power.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṁ iddhipādānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhunā dvinnaṁ phalānaṁ aññataraṁ phalaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: Because of developing and cultivating these four bases of psychic power, one of two results can be expected:

verses.pali: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
verses.english: enlightenment in this very life, or if there’s residue left behind, non-return.”
